CHARACTER_FORGE.ButtonHint: Open the Character Forge creation wizard.

Identity.Desc: Let's start with the basics of who your character is.
Identity.Name: Name
Identity.NameHint: Your character's name. You can change it later on the actor sheet.
Identity.AlignmentHint: Alignment describes how your character relates to law and chaos, good and evil. Skip if you'd rather decide through play.
Identity.PortraitHint: Path to an image file inside your Foundry data. You can set or change this later on the actor sheet.

Race.Desc: Pick your character's race. Each race grants ability score bonuses, traits, and a starting size & speed. Some races have subraces with extra options.
Race.SelectPrompt: Select a race above to see its full details.

CHARACTER_FORGE.ResetConfirmContent: This will discard everything you've entered so far. Are you sure?

Settings.DefaultAbilityMethodHint: Which method to preselect on the Ability Scores step.
Settings.AllowMulticlassHint: Enable the multiclass option in the Level Up wizard.
Settings.AllowFeatAtLevel1Hint: Per the optional rule in the PHB, characters gain one feat at character creation.
Settings.ImportedOverridesSrdHint: When an imported entry has the same key as an SRD entry, prefer the imported one.
Settings.AutoTickXpHint: Award XP to the actor automatically when the Level Up wizard completes.

Notify.NoName: Please enter a character name before continuing.
Notify.NoRace: Please choose a race before continuing.
Notify.NoSubrace: This race has subraces — please pick one before continuing.
Notify.DraftPending: Character Forge: a saved draft is available. Open the wizard to resume.
Notify.ForgeNotReady: Character Forge: creation pipeline is being assembled. More steps coming soon.
Notify.WrongSystem: Character Forge requires the D&D 5e system.
Notify.OldSystem: Character Forge requires D&D 5e {required}+. Detected version: {current}. Some features may not work.
Notify.SrdLoadError: Character Forge: failed to load the bundled SRD data. The wizard will not work until this is fixed.

Human.name: Human
Human.desc: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races.

Fighter.name: Fighter
Fighter.desc: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

Champion.name: Champion
Champion.desc: Focused on the physical perfection of body and weapon mastery.

Soldier.name: Soldier
Soldier.desc: War has been your life for as long as you care to remember.
